title: Web apps became real when pages stopped reloading
body: Gmail (2004) and Google Maps (2005) fetched data in the background with XMLHttpRequest instead of reloading whole pages, a bundle of tricks Jesse James Garrett named Ajax in 2005. The browser went from document viewer to application platform. Almost every modern web app is that idea, industrialised.
source_hint: Garrett, 'Ajax: A New Approach to Web Applications' (2005)
